templates.why_chosen: Reassigned from matrix by the note-writer: this is a hardware evaluation composite of five unlike panels, chip photo, zoomed photo, an area/power table, two waveform plots, not comparable cells, so it fits composite-figure or overview-with-inset better than matrix.
templates.what_to_learn: When bundling a chip photo, a zoomed detail, a results table and measured waveforms into one figure, treat it as an overview-plus-detail composite rather than forcing a matrix grid; the record's own weakness warns that packing five different panel types into one single-column figure makes every axis label too small to read.
